description:
AhaMotion turns complex topics into clear, animated explanations. Whether you are tackling K-12 assignments or just curious about the world, simply ask and view the concept visually.

1. Universal Concept Visualizer
Curious about “Why volcanoes erupt” or “How rain forms”? We break down general knowledge into easy-to-watch video summaries.

2. K-12 Science & Math Tutor
Visual Math Solver: Watch how functions graph and how geometric shapes transform to better understand Algebra and Geometry logic.
Science Visualization: Visualize concepts in Physics, Biology, Chemistry and related subjects.

3. General Learning Support
Turn study sessions into engaging visual stories. It acts as a tutor that draws key ideas out to support understanding and review.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect AhaMotion to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type "@AhaMotion"
Sample Prompts：
"@AhaMotion Generate a short educational video explaining how photosynthesis works."
"@AhaMotion Generate a video explaining Euler’s formula and its geometric meaning."
"@AhaMotion Create a video that explains the Pythagorean theorem for middle school students."

defaultPrompt: Show me a geometric proof of the Pythagorean theorem.
Show me square rotations (90, 180, 270) and symmetry.
